snapshot-stale.what: funko-tracker's last green commit (a41c09e2) is 14 commits and 26 hours behind the build's HEAD (FRD-14).
recipe: Extend `fixtureGit(repo)` (docs/design/prototype/scripts/make-fixtures.mjs) for repo `funko-tracker` (root `/workspace/funko-tracker`): answer the probe's commits-behind query (`rev-list --count a41c09e2..HEAD`) with `14` and the last-green commit time (`log -1 --format=%ct a41c09e2`) with HEAD time minus 26 h.

Default profile must answer BELOW both thresholds (SNAPSHOT_STALE_COMMITS_THRESHOLD 10, SNAPSHOT_STALE_HOURS_THRESHOLD 24, inclusive), e.g. 3 commits and 5 h, so `project-snapshot` shows no stale notice. The committed git-state.json has no entry for this probe: the double adds it, the committed file is not edited.
snapshot-stale.asserts: Both thresholds exceeded => `isSnapshotStale()` true => amber notice «Este commit quedó atrás del build».
snapshot-stale.oracle_text: El build lleva 14 commits y 26 horas más.
snapshot-stale.reader_today: WO-14-002 probe not built yet (snapshot.ts sets stale:false by default)

stats-stream-error.what: The usage event stream exists but cannot be parsed.
recipe: Overlay `home/.claude/dashboard-events.ndjson` (the file `PANDACORP_EVENTS_FILE` points at): keep the 6 valid default lines unchanged, then pad with blank lines up to physical line 213 and put one non-JSON line (`not json {`) at physical line 214. accounts-source-error.what: The private accounts file breaks its contract and one project link points to an unknown account, while every account stays listed.
recipe: Cannot be reproduced by files alone: in `readServicesDirectory()` a broken `accounts.yaml` makes `parseAccounts` throw and leaves `accounts: []` (src/lib/services/services.ts), so the directory would be empty, not the oracle's full list with two notices.

Reproduce with a harness-level decorator around the request-scoped `getServicesDirectory()`: read the default fixture, then append `{code:'invalid', source:'services/accounts.yaml'}` and `{code:'dangling', source:'projects/pandacast/.pandacorp/accounts/services.yaml'}` to `issues`.
Also open FRD-26: today the reader emits only `missing`/`invalid` with sources `accounts` / `project:<name>`; the oracle shows `dangling` and file-path sources.
accounts-source-error.asserts: Two issues rendered, all fixture accounts and allocations still present.

findings.title: Reader-generated sentences differ from the oracle's Spanish
findings.detail: Four scenarios (backlog-errors, model-invalid, worktrees-unreadable, stats-stream-error) show a sentence the prototype wrote in Spanish. The installed readers emit English reasons (`malformed YAML frontmatter`, `duplicate id … (already defined in …)`, `git read failed: …`, data-model validator messages). The file or git fault reproduces the STATE; the build must either map the reader's reason to the same Spanish copy or the detail line is masked in L3. Decide in the owning FRD, not in the gate.

findings.title: accounts-source-error cannot be a file fault
findings.detail: A broken accounts.yaml empties the whole directory in readServicesDirectory() (accounts: []), while the oracle keeps every account and adds two notices. It needs the reader-level injection described in the double. The reader also lacks the `dangling` code and the file-path sources the oracle draws (FRD-26 contract to align).

findings.title: Actions replay verbatim against prototype selectors
findings.detail: build.actions is `replay-verbatim`: the build gate runs the same click/fill/waitFor/scroll/js actions. The build must expose the same hooks (data-action, data-*, ids, roles) or S2.6 adds a per-state `build.actions` override. The distinct selectors are listed in `action_selectors`.

findings.title: Clock and git seams do not exist in src yet
findings.detail: Nothing in src reads MC_CLOCK or a git-state double. Server side: preload make-fixtures.mjs freezeClock(MC_CLOCK) (globalThis.Date override) with NODE_OPTIONS=--import. Browser side: Playwright context.clock fixed at the clock. Git: pendingMerge already takes an injectable GitRunner (feed it fixtureGit); achievements/report/scalars.ts shells `git rev-list --count HEAD` directly and falls back to 0 under the dead GIT_DIR, while the oracle shows the git-state.json commit count, so it needs the same seam.

findings.title: Prototype-only URL params are not route state
findings.detail: demo=off, host=page and theme=<t> are capture params; the build applies the theme by the app's own mechanism. `scene=on|off|sim` is a demo override: on equals the default profile, off is the scene-off double. `achievement=preview` is a review affordance (double achievement-preview).

findings.title: Two states reach UI by script, not by user input
findings.detail: shell-rail-float sets `#sidebar[data-float=true]` and the a11y/token states call `.focus()` from js. The build keeps the same `data-float` attribute (AppShell, components.md) and runs the same js; no double.
